mapper.select: SELECT r.*, c.cname as courseName, t.tname as teacherName, ct.term FROM studentms.resource r INNER JOIN studentms.ct ct ON r.ctid = ct.ctid INNER JOIN studentms.c c ON ct.cid = c.cid INNER JOIN studentms.t t ON ct.tid = t.tid WHERE ct.tid = #{tid};

SELECT r.*, c.cname as courseName, t.tname as teacherName, ct.term FROM studentms.resource r INNER JOIN studentms.ct ct ON r.ctid = ct.ctid INNER JOIN studentms.c c ON ct.cid = c.cid INNER JOIN studentms.t t ON ct.tid = t.tid INNER JOIN studentms.sct sct ON ct.cid = sct.cid AND ct.tid = sct.tid AND ct.term = sct.term WHERE sct.sid = #{sid};
mapper.update:
UPDATE studentms.resource
filename = #{resource.filename},
filepath = #{resource.filepath},
filesize = #{resource.filesize},
description = #{resource.description},
WHERE rid = #{resource.rid};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO studentms.resource (ctid, filename, filepath, filesize, upload_time, description) VALUES (#{resource.ctid}, #{resource.filename}, #{resource.filepath}, #{resource.filesize}, #{resource.uploadTime}, #{resource.description})
